title: Bare 'susi' prints status and the one next step
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Running 'susi' with no arguments and no tty shows readiness and exactly one suggested next action instead of waiting for input. Integration test zc_bare_susi.rs.
